issues.display_title: Issue #1755: UI/UX: Open Beta Release — hide monetization, add Beta label, feedback access
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Design/UX changes for the Villume Open Beta release. Based on:

  • docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-08-03-open-beta-release/brief.md
  • docs/superpowers/PRD/2026-08-03-open-beta-release/prd.md

Task Order #9165

Scope

  1. Hide monetization — pricing pages/sections/nav links, plan cards, plan comparison tables, subscribe buttons, billing pages, payment methods, invoices, upgrade prompts, add-ons/paid-feature prompts. Direct visits to pricing/billing pages show a simple beta message instead ("Villume is free to use during beta. Pricing and subscriptions will return after beta.") with a path back to the product.
  2. Remove limit pressure — no gallery/project/account-limit messages, no upgrade/contact-sales-because-of-limit prompts during beta.
  3. Add Beta labeling — small, clear, professional "Beta" label near Villume branding (marketing header, logged-in app header/dashboard, editor area). Must not appear on public visitor/shared-gallery pages.
  4. Add feedback access — feedback entry point via existing contact flow on logged-in/owner surfaces (dashboard, editor). Include context when possible (page, gallery/project, beta-feedback subject). Not shown on public visitor pages.
  5. Keep core flows fully open: sign up, create galleries, upload, edit, preview, publish, share — no invite-only gating, no new restrictions.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Beta label appears near branding, professional and non-distracting
  • Pricing pages/sections/nav/CTAs hidden; direct pricing URL shows beta message
  • Plan cards, comparison tables, subscribe/upgrade buttons hidden
  • Billing pages, payment methods, invoices, pending payment prompts hidden; direct billing URL shows beta message + path back
  • Add-ons and paid-feature prompts hidden
  • No account/gallery/project limit messages or upgrade-because-of-limit prompts
  • Core flows (signup, create, upload, edit, preview, publish, share) remain fully usable
  • Feedback link available on logged-in owner surfaces, uses existing contact flow, includes context
  • Public visitor pages show no beta controls or feedback prompts

RESULT
